subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a new core config surface after the no-override compatibility bug is fixed?
rationale: The mechanical compatibility defect is clear, but accepting a new prompt-context config knob affects session behavior, hook extras, and overlapping context-control work.

options.title: Sponsor after compatibility fix
options.body: Proceed with this PR once the no-override path preserves current hook-extra behavior and docs/tests make the new explicit tiers clear.

options.title: Fold into broader context design
options.body: Pause this PR and design one selector contract that covers bootstrap tiers, lightweight mode, hook extras, and related prompt-pressure issues together.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Keep existing controls such as `contextInjection`, bootstrap budgets, and lightweight mode, and close the feature direction as not planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after compatibility fix
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR once the no-override path preserves current hook-extra behavior and docs/tests make the new explicit tiers clear.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest history signal on subagent bootstrap limiting and already provided maintainer-side review context on the linked issue.
